content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, was ordered because the patient presents with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and episodes of dizziness (R42) that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
